messages.subject: Pass parameters to an Rmd dynamic document
parts:
Hi
I have a dynamic document, I deployed it from within RStudio using the Publish button.

Is there a way to pass a url parameter to the document such that I can use them later in the report? 
Say, to change the title of the generated report or choose the data to generate the report with?

Best

Hi Juan,
I don't believe there is a way to do that today, but we have talked about potentially extending R markdown documents to allow for the parameterization of the output.  I will check with a few of our engineers to see if they know.
Best,
